name: MHRA authorises weekly insulin Onswik
summary: The MHRA has authorised Onswik (insulin efsitora alfa), a once-weekly insulin injection, for adults with type 2 diabetes.
keyPoints: The MHRA authorised Onswik (insulin efsitora alfa) for adults with type 2 diabetes on 13 October 2026.
The MHRA says it may reduce the number of injections needed from up to 365 a year to 52.

body.heading: What was announced
body.body: The MHRA says it has authorised Onswik (insulin efsitora alfa) for adults with type 2 diabetes. Onswik is a once-weekly injection, and the MHRA says this treatment option may reduce the number of injections needed from up to 365 a year to 52.

body.heading: What it means
body.body: The MHRA says clinical trial data showed that once-weekly insulin efsitora alfa gave blood sugar control comparable to once-daily basal insulin in adults with type 2 diabetes.
